content_of_post_to_comment: Fiction writers, I'm curious! Do your characters ever surprise you by doing something you hadn't originally planned? This could be anything from a sudden new hobby to murdering another character! Let me know what you’ve had happen? I love hearing about those moments when a story seems to take on a life of its own. I’ve been there when I wrote, and it’s rather a strange ordeal. You’re typing and suddenly BOOM it’s not what you thought anymore.
comment: I wonder if characters surprise us because we've finally stopped forcing them to serve the plot. Sometimes the unexpected choice reveals a more believable character than the original outline ever could.
